notes: Guide: on the southern seashore of the Gludio territory; level 20-30 monsters. Levels: "lvl" is the guide/overview range; the datapack monsters inside are level 20-30 (lvlDatapack). Entrance (surface mouth) was derived from the L2J geodata: walking the underground corridor from the outer Gatekeeper Ziggurat ends ~3,300 units away at a shaft whose top opens onto the field (middle geodata layer, connected to open ground). Not yet verified in game. Entry hall, both Ziggurats, teleport-in/out coordinates, bypasses (necro/cata <id>, exit <id>), monsters and raid bosses are from the L2J High Five datapack (spawnlist, teleport.sql, html/teleporter/<npcId>.htm, L2DungeonGatekeeperInstance). Seven Signs rule (L2J core): the outer Ziggurat only lets you in if you are registered with Dawn or Dusk; during the Seal Validation period only members of the winning side that also owns the Seal of Avarice (necropolis) / Seal of Gnosis (catacomb). Refusal shows "necro_no"/"cata_no" ("Did you think you could deceive me? You may not pass."). Whether L2Toggle enforces this is NOT verified. Live gatekeeper Bella (Gludio) lists "Necropolis of Sacrifice"; landing point unknown (not in datapack). Interior lies right next to the entry hall (same map region); the Ziggurat teleport moves you only a few hundred units, past the sealed door. "aggressive" per monster = name listed in Scripts/data/aggro_h5.json. "adena"/"sealStones" = death drop list in Scripts/data/npcstats. Every monster drops EITHER seal stones (Lilim, Nephilim, Lith, Gigant ... no adena) OR adena (the others, no seal stones).

notes: Guide page is images only (location map, dungeon map, mob map); no text details beyond the general Seven Signs rules. Levels: "lvl" is the guide/overview range; the datapack monsters inside are level 72-78 (lvlDatapack). Entrance (surface mouth) was derived from the L2J geodata: walking the underground corridor from the outer Gatekeeper Ziggurat ends ~3,300 units away at a shaft whose top opens onto the field (middle geodata layer, connected to open ground). Not yet verified in game. Entry hall, both Ziggurats, teleport-in/out coordinates, bypasses (necro/cata <id>, exit <id>), monsters and raid bosses are from the L2J High Five datapack (spawnlist, teleport.sql, html/teleporter/<npcId>.htm, L2DungeonGatekeeperInstance). Seven Signs rule (L2J core): the outer Ziggurat only lets you in if you are registered with Dawn or Dusk; during the Seal Validation period only members of the winning side that also owns the Seal of Avarice (necropolis) / Seal of Gnosis (catacomb). Refusal shows "necro_no"/"cata_no" ("Did you think you could deceive me? You may not pass."). Whether L2Toggle enforces this is NOT verified. Live gatekeeper Valentina (Oren) lists "Catacomb of Dark Omens"; landing point unknown (not in datapack). Interior lies right next to the entry hall (same map region); the Ziggurat teleport moves you only a few hundred units, past the sealed door. "aggressive" per monster = name listed in Scripts/data/aggro_h5.json. "adena"/"sealStones" = death drop list in Scripts/data/npcstats. Every monster drops EITHER seal stones (Lilim, Nephilim, Lith, Gigant ... no adena) OR adena (the others, no seal stones).
